AnimaArtistTagSelector.description: Select multiple artist style tags visually through an advanced preview grid panel.

artist_tags.name: Artist Tags
artist_tags.tooltip: Plain STRING artist prompt text filled by the visual selector. Use the Tagged variant for chip management.

mode.name: Concatenation Mode
mode.tooltip: Append selected tags to optional input prompt, or override it completely.

opt_prompt.name: Optional Prompt
opt_prompt.tooltip: An optional input prompt text slot to merge with selected tags.

AnimaPromptComposer.description: Randomly draw artist, character, clothing, background, and pose prompt tags from the full built-in data range at workflow runtime.

enable_artist.name: Enable Artist
enable_artist.tooltip: When disabled, artist candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_character.name: Enable Character
enable_character.tooltip: When disabled, character candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_clothing.name: Enable Clothing
enable_clothing.tooltip: When disabled, clothing candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_background.name: Enable Background
enable_background.tooltip: When disabled, background candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_pose.name: Enable Pose
enable_pose.tooltip: When disabled, pose candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

character_detail.name: Character Detail
character_detail.tooltip: Choose whether character output uses only trigger words or trigger words plus full feature tags.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Use -1 for a fresh random result each run, or a fixed number for reproducible random selection.

artist_count.name: Artist Count
artist_count.tooltip: Number of random artists to use. Character, clothing, background, and pose always select one each when enabled.

preview_collapsed.name: Preview Collapsed
preview_collapsed.tooltip: Internal saved state for the collapsible preview.

resolved_prompt.name: Resolved Prompt
resolved_prompt.tooltip: Plain STRING text box storing the latest random result. Use the Tagged variant for chip management.

enable_character.name: Enable Character

enable_clothing.tooltip: When disabled, clothing candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

enable_background.tooltip: When disabled, background candidates are ignored and not included in the output.

artist_count.name: Artist Count
artist_count.tooltip: Number of random artists to use. Character, clothing, background, and pose always select one each when enabled.

preview_collapsed.name: Preview Collapsed
preview_collapsed.tooltip: Internal saved state for the collapsible preview.

AnimaMultiCharacterComposer.description: Compose hybrid Anima prompts for two to four characters. Shared content uses tags, while each character receives a position-aware English description to reduce attribute confusion.

character_count.name: Character Count
character_count.tooltip: Enable two, three, or four character slots. Values in temporarily hidden slots are preserved.

layout.name: Layout Preset
layout.tooltip: Choose a spatial layout compatible with the current character count.

global_tags.name: Global Tags
global_tags.tooltip: Optional quality, style, artist, or other shared Danbooru tags. Empty by default; the node never adds implicit tags.

character_1_gender.name: Character 1 Gender
character_1_gender.tooltip: Used to generate the cast count tags.

character_1_prompt.name: Character 1 Prompt
character_1_prompt.tooltip: Character name, role, and intrinsic appearance, such as 'Hatsune Miku, with long turquoise twin-tails'. Required.

character_1_clothing.name: Character 1 Clothing Prompt
character_1_clothing.tooltip: A separate clothing description for this character, such as 'a white dress'. Optional.

character_1_pose.name: Character 1 Pose Prompt
character_1_pose.tooltip: A separate pose, action, and expression description, such as 'standing, waving, smiling'. Optional.

character_2_gender.name: Character 2 Gender
character_2_gender.tooltip: Used to generate the cast count tags.

character_2_prompt.name: Character 2 Prompt
character_2_prompt.tooltip: Character name, role, and intrinsic appearance. Required.

character_2_clothing.name: Character 2 Clothing Prompt
character_2_clothing.tooltip: A separate clothing description for this character. Optional.

character_2_pose.name: Character 2 Pose Prompt
character_2_pose.tooltip: A separate pose, action, and expression description. Optional.

character_3_gender.name: Character 3 Gender
character_3_gender.tooltip: Used for cast count tags in three- or four-character mode.

character_3_prompt.name: Character 3 Prompt
character_3_prompt.tooltip: Character name, role, and intrinsic appearance required in three- or four-character mode.

character_3_clothing.name: Character 3 Clothing Prompt
character_3_clothing.tooltip: A separate clothing description for this character. Optional.

character_3_pose.name: Character 3 Pose Prompt
character_3_pose.tooltip: A separate pose, action, and expression description. Optional.

character_4_gender.name: Character 4 Gender
character_4_gender.tooltip: Used for cast count tags in four-character mode.

character_4_prompt.name: Character 4 Prompt
character_4_prompt.tooltip: Character name, role, and intrinsic appearance required in four-character mode.

character_4_clothing.name: Character 4 Clothing Prompt
character_4_clothing.tooltip: A separate clothing description for this character. Optional.

character_4_pose.name: Character 4 Pose Prompt
character_4_pose.tooltip: A separate pose, action, and expression description. Optional.

interaction.name: Interaction
interaction.tooltip: Optional English phrase appended after 'The characters are', such as 'holding hands and looking at each other'.

scene.name: Scene
scene.tooltip: Optional English scene description appended after 'The scene is'.

lora_list_json.name: LoRA List
